entries.en: As the historical anecdote came to a close, the scene shifted to the silent match room. Sitting before the board was the young shogi player, Tsumii Shuichi, striving to achieve the seven crowns. The voice announcing the moves indicated that the deadline for victory or defeat was drawing ever closer. The weight of the turn hung heavily in the air, creating a tense atmosphere in the room. The recorders and spectators around them were frozen in place, unable to move. Only the second hand of the clock quietly awaited the next move. No one spoke; that was the etiquette of the match room.
